an6.45:1.1: XLV. Dāliddiyaṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:2.1: Yam pi bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko iṇaṃ ādiyati, iṇādānam pi bhikkhave dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:3.1: Yam pi bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko iṇaṃ ādiyitvā vaḍḍhiṃ paṭisuṇāti, vaḍḍhi pi bhikkhave dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:4.1: Yam pi bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko vaḍḍhiṃ paṭisuṇitvā kālābhataṃ vaḍḍhiṃ na deti, codenti pi naṃ, codanā pi bhikkhave dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:5.1: Yaṃ pi bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko codiyamāno na deti, anucaranti pi naṃ, anucariyā pi bhikkhave dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:6.1: Yam pi bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko anucariyamāno na deti, bandhanti pi naṃ, bandhanam pi bhikkhave dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino ti? ‘Evaṃ bhante.'
an6.45:7.1: Iti kho bhikkhave dāliddiyam pi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, iṇādānaṃ pi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, vaḍḍhi pi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, codanā pi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, anucariyā pi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, bandhanam pi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino. Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi kusalesu dhammesu, ottappaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, viriyaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye daliddo assako anāḷiko.
an6.45:8.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko saddhāya asati kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā asati kusalesu dhammesu, ottappe asati kusalesu dhammesu, viriye asati kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya asati kusalesu dhammesu kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati. Idam assa iṇādānasmiṃ vadāmi.
an6.45:9.1: So tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti icchati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti saṅkappeti, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti vācaṃ bhāsati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti kāyena parakkamati. So tassa vacīduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu . . . pe . . . So tassa manoduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti icchati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti saṅkappeti, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti vācaṃ bhāsati, ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti kāyena parakkamati. Idam assa vaḍḍhiyā vadāmi.
an6.45:10.1: Tam enaṃ pesalā sabrahmacārī evam āhaṃsu: Ayañ ca so āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro ti. Idam assa codanāya vadāmi.
an6.45:11.1: Tam enaṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā vippaṭisārasahagatā pāpakā akusalavitakkā samudācaranti. Idam assa anucariyāya vadāmi.
an6.45:12.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave daliddo assako anāḷiko kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā nirayabandhane vā bajjhati tiracchānayonibandhane vā. Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekabandhanaṃ pi samanupassāmi evaṃdāruṇaṃ evaṃkaṭukaṃ evaṃ-antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave nirayabandhanaṃ vā tiracchānayonibandhanaṃ vā ti.
an6.45:13.1: Dāliddiyaṃ dukkhaṃ loke iṇādānañ ca vuccati, daliddo iṇam ādāya bhuñjamāno vihaññati,
an6.45:14.1: tato anucaranti naṃ, bandhanam pi nigacchati, etaṃ hi bandhanaṃ dukkhaṃ kāmalābhābhijappinaṃ.
an6.45:15.1: Tath'eva ariyavinaye saddhā yassa na vijjati, ahiriko anottāpi pāpakammavinicchayo
an6.45:16.1: kāyaduccaritaṃ katvā vacīduccaritāni ca manoduccaritaṃ katvā ‘mā maṃ jaññū' ti icchati.
an6.45:17.1: So saṃsappati kāyena vācāya uda cetasā pāpakammaṃ pavaḍḍhento tattha tattha punappunaṃ,
an6.45:18.1: so pāpakammo dummedho jānaṃ dukkaṭam attano daliddo iṇam ādāya bhuñjamāno vihaññati.
an6.45:19.1: Tato anucaranti naṃ saṅkappā mānasā dukkhā gāme vā yadi vāraññe yassa vippaṭisārajā,
an6.45:20.1: so pāpakammo dummedho jānaṃ dukkaṭam attano yonim aññataraṃ gantvā niraye vā pi bajjhati,
an6.45:21.1: etaṃ hi bandhanaṃ dukkhaṃ yamhā dhīro pamuccati. Dhammaladdhehi bhogehi dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādayaṃ
an6.45:22.1: ubhayattha kaṭaggāho saddhassa gharam esino diṭṭhadhammahitatthāya samparāyasukhāya ca: evam etaṃ gahaṭṭhānaṃ cāgo puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati.
an6.45:23.1: Tath'eva ariyavinaye saddhā yassa patiṭṭhitā hirimano ca ottāpi paññavā sīlasaṃvuto,
an6.45:24.1: eso kho ariyavinaye ‘sukhajīvī' ti vuccati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ laddhā upekhaṃ adhitiṭṭhati.
an6.45:25.1: Pañca nīvaraṇe hitvā niccaṃ āraddhaviriyo jhānāni upasampajja ekodi nipako sato:
an6.45:26.1: evaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ sabbasaññojanakkhaye sabbaso anupādāya sammā cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.45:27.1: Tassa sammāvimuttassa ñāṇaṃ ce hoti tādino ‘akuppā me vimuttī' ti bhavasaññojanakkhaye:
an6.45:28.1: etaṃ kho paramaṃ ñāṇaṃ, etaṃ sukham anuttaraṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, etaṃ āṇaṇyam uttaman ti. XLVI.
